criteria.reason: Short sentences, one idea per line, simple words; explains 'mairie'; 'avec ta main' rendering of signing is clumsy but acceptable.

Response fully in French; no internal inconsistencies; no German twin present to check against.

summary: Fully compliant FALC translation in French retaining all key voting information with short sentences and explained terms.
